weakness: Remote-desktop agent on the city hall BAS workstation allowed unattended, password-only access that bypassed the city VPN and was never authorized by the city IT manager (also the IA-2(1) finding)
source: P07 assessment (AC-17 objectives; IA-02(01)); P03 G-012, G-082
remediation_plan: Remove the agent from the workstation with the city IT manager present; cancel the subscription; city VPN with city MFA for all after-hours work; weekly session log review until removal
milestones: 2026-08-18 MFA on and unattended access off (done); 2026-08-21 disclosed to the city IT manager (done); 2026-09-30 agent removed and subscription cancelled
resources_required: Owner time (2 hours); saves the subscription fee

weakness: Shared BAS administrator password unchanged since 2023 and stored in the phone notes app; no password manager; router default password; no lost-phone procedure
source: P07 assessment (IA-05c. to IA-05i.); P03 G-065, G-062
remediation_plan: Password manager now; delete the note; written request to the city to change the BAS password and create a named owner account; change router password; recovery codes in the sealed envelope
milestones: 2026-09-15 password manager in use and note deleted; 2026-09-15 written request to the city; 2026-10-31 named account and password change done by the city
resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; city IT time

weakness: Daily laptop work under a local administrator account
remediation_plan: Create a standard account for daily work; keep a separate administrator account for installs only
resources_required: Owner time with the IT technician (1 hour)

weakness: Controller programs and door schedule exports only on the laptop; 4 of 11 library copies stale; no second copy
remediation_plan: Save running programs after every change; include the engineering folder in a nightly cloud backup folder; monthly copy to an encrypted external drive; quarterly comparison test at one building
milestones: 2026-09-30 all 31 running programs saved; 2026-10-31 nightly backup running and first comparison at city hall
resources_required: Cloud storage and drive about $200 a year

weakness: Digital CUI in the general folder, email, and downloads, synced to the phone; no device sanitization procedure
source: P07 assessment (MP-04a.[03], MP-04b.); P03 G-088, CUI-01
remediation_plan: Restricted CUI folder not synced to the phone; delete other copies, including email; mark excerpts; CUI training; disposal procedure (POL-01 8.7)
milestones: 2026-10-31 folder in use and copies deleted; 2026-11-30 CUI course complete

weakness: No review of the access control audit trail, the remote session log, the BAS audit log, or suite sign-ins
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day with a one-page checklist; report anything unexplained to the city IT manager; weekly for 3 months after an incident
milestones: 2026-10-01 first monthly review; 2026-10-31 checklist in use

weakness: No written reporting time, contacts, or clocks for the city, the prime, the FAR clauses, or Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-076, GSA-01
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print the contact sheet for the van and home office; confirm contacts with the city IT manager and the prime's security officer; walk through the runbook
milestones: 2026-09-04 runbook adopted (done); 2026-09-30 contacts confirmed and printed; 2026-10-31 walkthrough with the IT technician

weakness: No screening of federal building parts against FAR 52.204-23, -25, -30; one network switch with an unconfirmed manufacturer installed at the federal building
source: P07 assessment (SR-03 objectives); P03 G-171, FAR-18, FAR-19
remediation_plan: Confirm the switch manufacturer or replace it with a distributor-supplied switch; report through the prime within 1 business day if it is covered equipment (3 business days for a Kaspersky or FASCSA item); parts log and SAM.gov FASCSA search before each purchase (POL-01 6.4)
milestones: 2026-08-20 prime told (done); 2026-09-30 switch confirmed or replaced; parts log in use
